items.title: NFL issues season-high 10 fines for player safety fouls in Week 4
items.text: The NFL's announced Week 4 fines featured a season-high 10 infractions for player safety fouls that qualify toward a possible suspension.

items.text: The 49ers released defensive end Matthew Judon from the practice squad on Saturday.

items.title: 49ers activate DL Mykel Williams, who will make his 2026 debut Sunday
items.text: The 49ers activated defensive lineman Mykel Williams from the reserve/physically unable to perform list, the team announced Saturday.

items.text: Cornerback Trevon Diggs made his Seahawks debut last Sunday and he moved up to the active roster on a lasting basis Saturday.

items.title: Chargers put Trey Lance on injured reserve, make several other roster moves
items.text: The Chargers announced a flurry of roster moves ahead of Sunday's game against the Broncos, including quarterback Trey Lance's move to injured reserve.

items.title: Cardinals place RG Isaiah Adams on IR

items.title: DJ Moore questionable, Ed Oliver out for Bills on Monday night
items.text: Bills wide receiver DJ Moore was at Saturday's practice in a red non-contact jersey and it remains to be seen if he'll be in the lineup against the Rams on Monday night.

items.title: Falcons place LB Yasir Abdullah on IR
items.text: The Falcons placed linebacker Yasir Abdullah on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, the team announced Saturday.

items.title: Steelers WR Michael Pittman headed to IR

items.title: Bears activate LB Noah Sewell from PUP
items.text: The Bears activated linebacker Noah Sewell from reserve/PUP, the team announced Saturday.

items.title: Vikings will elevate Odell Beckham Jr. from practice squad

items.title: Colts put Arden Key on IR, elevate Nick Westbrook-Ikhine
items.text: Word this week was that Colts defensive end Arden Key will miss multiple weeks with a hamstring injury and the team confirmed it on Saturday.

items.title: Browns elevate DTs Sam Kamara, Chris Williams from practice squad
items.text: The Browns have elevated defensive tackle Sam Kamara and defensive tackle Chris Williams from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Jets, the team announced.

items.title: Report: Ravens conducted Cam Jurgens's physical at Eagles facility before finalizing trade
items.text: The Ravens completed a trade with the Eagles for center Cam Jurgens this week and they handled the final steps before the deal was done differently than their last high-profile attempt at a swap.
